validity_envelope_text: This report is not a replacement for real user research. It contains no willingness-to-pay estimates. It contains no population percentage extrapolations. It makes no ISO 9241-11 compliance claim.
narrative: CR8-MIN8 reverse-direction derivation-lock RED fixture (F191 mirror of run-status-derived-blocked-mismatch-bad.json): the per-persona run_status list is 3-of-3 completed, so the value DERIVED under F49's counted-set rule is NOT-BLOCKED (3 personas in the not-blocked floor set {completed, patience-exhausted, runner-capped}), but the stored top-level run_status hand-sets 'BLOCKED'. F191's 'disagrees' wording is symmetric: report-gate.mjs must RECOMPUTE and exit nonzero on a falsely-BLOCKED healthy run just as it does on a falsely-completed failed run — a builder implementing only `if (derivedBlocked && stored !== 'BLOCKED') reject` (never checking the reverse) would silently accept this findings file that falsely claims BLOCKED on a clean run.
